details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 3, Healer

A radiant dawn-priest who keeps the Keepers standing and the dark at bay. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn; believes every bad night ends in a morning. Joined the Keepers because Burrow's Den needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.

In a fight

Open with Bless or Prayer, keep allies up with Cure spells and Healing Circle, Hold Person a hobgoblin, and save Flame Strike for the troll.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spell Use. Divine caster, Wisdom. Spell DC 17. Prepare 12 spells each morning from the Cleric list (9 level + 3 Wis); cantrips are extra. Slots below include the Wisdom bonus slots.

Turn Undead. Action, 6 times per day: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save (DC 17). Fail: destroyed if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned (flees, cannot come within 30ft for 1 minute).

Granted Power: Dawning Light. Advantage on your first attack roll each round against undead. Once per day: a 20ft burst of dawn light; undead in it make a Will save or flee for 1 minute.

Weapon Selection. Cleric weapon list plus Lathander's favoured weapon, the heavy mace.

Resistance to necrotic and radiant. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant damage.

Lay on Hands. Once per long rest, heal a creature 9 HP (your level).

Inner light. Once per long rest, shed bright light in a 10ft radius (illumination only).

Fearless. Advantage on saves against being Frightened.

Chosen skill. Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks (combined with your NWP).

Darkvision. 60ft.

War Caster (1st, Arcane & Devout). Cast somatic spells with mace and shield in hand. Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep a spell when damaged.

Healer (4th, Arcane & Devout). Healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included in the spell lines). Once per day, cast one healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

Toughness (8th, General). +1 Max HP per level (+9, included), +1 Constitution (included: Con 16), Advantage on Constitution checks.

Speed, initiative and HP. Speed: 30ft · Initiative: +1 · HP: Level 1: d8 max 8 + Con +2 = 10. Levels 2-9: 8 x (5 + 2) = 56. Toughness: +1 x 9 levels = 9. Total 75.

Casting

Every spell is resolved by the target's save against your DC. Tick a slot box when you cast; slots return after a full rest. Cantrips are cast at will. Prepare 12 spells each morning from the Cleric list (9 level + 3 Wis); cantrips are extra. Slots include the Wisdom bonus slots. Healer feat: healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included); once per day, cast one healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

Cantrips: Sacred Flame (60ft, one creature: 2d4 radiant, Reflex DC 17 negates; cover gives no help). Toll the Dead (60ft, one creature: 2d4 necrotic, 2d6 if it is already hurt, Will DC 17 negates). First Aid (touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll; restores no HP). Light (touch an object: bright light 20ft + dim 20ft for 9 hours). Detect Magic (self, 60ft cone, 9 rounds: see which creatures/objects carry magic and the strongest school; ritual).

1st: Cure Light Wounds (touch: heals 1d8+6 HP, 1d8+5 +1 from Healer). Bless (50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on the first attack roll each round and +1 to saves; reverse (Bane) on 6 enemies, Will negates). Command (30ft, one creature that understands you: Approach, Drop, Flee or Halt on its next turn; Will DC 17 negates; mindless immune). Guiding Bolt (120ft, one creature: 3d8 radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves; next attack on it before your next turn ends has Advantage, a save negates that).

2nd: Aid (touch, 9 minutes: Advantage on first attack each round, +1 to saves, 1d8 temporary HP; does not stack with Bless). Hold Person (120ft, one humanoid, hobgoblins count: Paralysed for 9 rounds, repeats the save each turn; Will DC 17 negates). Spiritual Weapon (60ft, 9 rounds: a spectral weapon automatically hits one creature within 5ft of it each of your turns for 1d6+3 force; move it 30ft a round; AC 15, 10 HP).

3rd: Cure Serious Wounds (touch: heals 2d8+11 HP, 2d8+9 +2 from Healer). Prayer (40ft radius on you, 9 rounds: allies get Advantage on first attack each round and +1 damage and saves; enemies get Disadvantage on first attack and -1 damage and saves; no save). Spirit Guardians (self, 15ft radius, moves with you, 9 rounds: enemies there move at half speed and take 1d6 radiant, or necrotic chosen when cast, once per round when they enter or start their turn there; Will DC 17 halves).

4th: Healing Circle (range 30ft, 20ft burst: every living creature in it heals 1d8+10 HP, 1d8+9 +1 from Healer; careful: heals enemies in the burst too).

5th: Flame Strike (60ft, 10ft-radius 40ft-high cylinder: 9d6, half fire and half radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves; the fire half stops the troll regenerating).

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 8 (Plate Mail +1) + 0 (heavy armour: no Dex) + 1 (Medium Steel Shield) = 19

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol — every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = 10 + half your Cleric level (rounded down, minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Holy Campaign

  • Effect: Raise 1–100 NPCs with d8 HD plus 1–100 NPCs with d4 HD. All gain +1 on checks while the Cleric is present.
  • Scales at 19th: 2–200 / 2–200 NPCs, bonus increases to +2
  • Scales at 23rd: 4–400 / 4–400 NPCs, bonus increases to +3, gains 1st/2nd/3rd level leaders per 20 troops

20th Level

  • Perfect Recall: recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot; from 24th level it also works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

21st Level

Banish

  • Effect: Turn-undead-equivalent ability used against extraplanar creatures.
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: Permanent 20ft aura that radiates divine power. Cannot be dispelled.
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • +3 to the Turn Undead DC
  • +2 to all attribute checks and saves within the aura

23rd Level

Mark of the Saint

  • Effect: Recognised as a saint regardless of alignment.
  • Gains 1d10 followers per Wisdom point
  • Grants weekly: Heal, Remove Blindness or Deafness, Remove Disease
  • Grants daily: Holy or Unholy Word
  • Grants weekly: Resurrection

Deities — Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power.
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.

Standing in the thick of a fight doesn't rattle you the way it does most spellcasters.
